county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings - on Sides (26 TAC §746.4807(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One side of swing structure has a use zone of one foot.

top_violation_types.title: Animals - Notify Parents in Writing (26 TAC §746.3901(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained, there was not a written notice to notify the parents that there would be a dog present at the operation.

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CCR observed stationary equipment positioned less than six feet from the perimeter.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.3501(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Diaper changing supplies were within children's reach in two classrooms.

top_violation_types.title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Responsible for Snack if Parent Does Not Provide (26 TAC §746.3309(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: USDA requires snacks to include two meal components out of five (milk, grains, vegetables, fruits, and meat).  Center is providing one component for snack.

top_violation_types.title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the walk through a trash can with food waste was observed in reach of children and accessible.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.
